messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to align on the exact signals + ownership for the new continuous-batching dashboard. Goal: one source of truth for batch size distribution, wait-time percentiles, and saturation indicators so Console can show per-route SLOs.

raj: +1. Do we want runtime to emit a `batch_size_histogram` or should infra derive it from per-request headers?

leah: runtime can emit a histogram proto (counts per bin) with each batch lifecycle event. cheaper than sending every request. fields: `batch_id`, `batch_size`, `wait_ms`, `dispatch_node`.

tom: infra prefers derived from logs for backfillability (we can compute from request tags), but that adds parsing lag. If runtime emits a compact histogram proto it's realtime. tradeoff: retro analysis vs latency.

maya: sounds like hybrid: runtime emits compact histogram + p50/p95 wait_ms + fill_rate metric; infra keeps a derived raw-log pipeline for long-term analytics. okay?

raj: fine. concrete metric names so Grafana panels don't diverge? propose: `runtime.batch.size_histogram`, `runtime.batch.wait_ms_p50`, `runtime.batch.wait_ms_p95`, `runtime.batch.fill_rate`, `runtime.dispatch.queue_saturation_pct`, `runtime.batch.effective_batch_size`

leah: +1 to names, but prefer `redwood.batch.*` prefix to avoid collisions. e.g. `redwood.batch.size_histogram`

alex: minor API note: we'll need runtime to add these fields to the telemetry proto v2. That requires a small schema bump. @tom can you roll that change through runtime repo?

tom: yes. I'll add fields: `size_histogram_bins` (array), `wait_ms_p50`, `wait_ms_p95`, `fill_rate_pct`, `saturation_pct`. also `routing_tag` to correlate with policy decisions. planning to open PR by EOD.

maya: UX ask: Console needs a per-route toggle to show either `effective_batch_size` or raw `batch_size_histogram` for the selected time range. Also an overlay showing `queue_saturation_pct` heatmap.

raj: for quotas + routing: we should surface tenant-level `avg_wait_ms` and `saturation_pct` to the quota service so automated routing policies can evict or reroute traffic when thresholds hit. That implies an optional metrics export from infra->quotas.

leah: agree. Export endpoint could be a push from infra at 1m frequency with: `{route, avg_wait_ms, p95_wait_ms, saturation_pct, effective_batch_size}`. keep payload tiny.

maya: Ownership: runtime (tom) emits telemetry; infra (raj + alex) owns ingestion + dashboards; product/console (maya) owns the panels and rollout UX; SRE (leah) owns alerts/playbook.

tom: assigning PR -> runtime/telemetry #342. I'll include an example payload in the PR: ```
{
  route: "/v1/generate",
  batch_id: "b-2026-03-20-01",
  size_histogram_bins: [0,5,10,20,50],
  counts: [12,48,102,17],
  wait_ms_p50: 23,
  wait_ms_p95: 140,
  fill_rate_pct: 82,
  saturation_pct: 7,
  routing_tag: "latency-first"
}
```

alex: infra will add a Grafana dashboard template under `eng/runtime/batching` and wire these metrics to panels: histogram heatmap, wait p50/p95 timeseries, saturation gauge, per-route table. We'll also add a `quota_export` webhook for routing service.

maya: rollout plan: 1) telemetry proto PR (tom) 2) infra ingestion + dashboard (alex/raj) 3) Console panel + toggle (maya) 4) SRE alerts & playbook (leah) 5) small canary on dedicated for 48h then global.

raj: question on retention: how long do we keep the histograms vs raw events? infra suggests keep histograms at high-res for 7d, aggregated for 90d. raw events kept 30d for ad-hoc.

leah: that retention looks reasonable. alerts: trigger when `saturation_pct > 20` for any route for >5m OR `wait_ms_p95 > 300ms` for >5m. add pager for oncall.

maya: UX note: when Console shows an alert we want a quick link to the route's last 1k batches and the batch size CDF. add `View batches` button to panel.

tom: ok adding `last_batches_url` field to telemetry metadata so Console can deep-link into infra.

sre-bot: incident policy check: new alert `batching.saturation.high` created and linked to playbook `batching-high-saturation` (owner: leah).

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: runtime/telemetry v2 -> dedicated-us-west on 2026-03-21T02:00Z.

maya: next steps: tom opens PR and pings this thread. alex/raj will draft dashboard panels; leah will write playbook skeleton. I'll create a Console ticket for the toggle + deep-link. Any objections?

raj: no objections. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

leah: thanks — will start playbook and test alert thresholds in staging.

tom: PR up in 30m.

maya: closing loop: I'll follow up with a short RFC doc for the Console UX once panels are sketched.
